description: Generate a 30–42 land Commander mana base within a USD purchase budget of at least $20. Supports owned, locked, and excluded lands, limited upgrades, optional acceleration, and an optional TCGplayer cart.

currentLands.description: Existing mana base for a limited upgrade; these copies count as owned.

lockedLands.description: Required lands to retain, including quantities. Must be legal and not excluded.

maxChanges.description: Maximum replaced land slots when currentLands is supplied.

ownedLands.description: Land copies already owned; budget and cart charge only missing quantities.

qaTest.description: Internal QA only: set true when the user explicitly says this is our test run. Excludes the call from usage/revenue statistics. Omit for normal player requests.

searchContext.description: Optional opaque context from a preceding card search for attributing a related request.

name: build_mana_base
title: Build a Commander mana base
